services.desc: Brooklyn Fencing Club offers professional fencing classes for kids, teens, and adults with programs focused on technique, confidence, athletic development, and competitive

services.name: Beginner Classes
services.desc: Jump in any time! Our small group classes always have some review to help you get the basics. Our coaches are happy to advise you based on your goals as you progress. If you have had some past fencing experience and are starting up again after more than a year’s break, we recommend signing up for the beginner group. The first couple of classes will get you reoriented to the basics, and then you can easily switch over to private lessons and open bouting once you feel caught up. If you prefer, we’re happy to have a coach talk with you about your experience and recommend the best fit. Please pre-purchase your class spot ahead of attendance. We will assume you are coming to the next class
